host.notes: Private offline normalizer qualification; identifying filesystem prefixes were redacted.

commands.purpose: Build and retain phase evidence using staged LLVM 21 llvm-objcopy from the first clean prefix.
Repeat the offline staged-LLVM build from distinct Swift and build prefixes.
Require byte identity between the two staged-LLVM outputs.

expectedBehavior: Two clean offline builds using one staged normalizer produce byte-identical xtool and XADI files without weakening the complete-file hash gate.
observedBehavior: The candidate failed qualification. LLVM changed XADI relative to the active lock, and xtool retained 59 differing .rodata bytes. Every difference was a Swift #file literal containing the distinct physical SwiftPM scratch prefix; Swift debug/file prefix maps did not rewrite those runtime strings.
limitations: This failed build-only experiment does not evaluate signing, deployment, launch, device runtime, Rider, or Uno.
Raw binaries and path-bearing forensic captures remain private and are not published by the repository.
nextDecision: Reject staged LLVM normalization and qualify a fixed logical SwiftPM path with source-built, hash-locked GNU Binutils before any output rebaseline.

redaction.notes: Hashes, versions, phase outcome, and the 59-byte .rodata cause are retained without private prefixes.

localLogReferences: operator-controlled xtool LLVM qualification captures retained outside the repository
